title: Combined DP and T1 pool holding upload (BOW front end, COMBINED DP UPLOAD WITH T1 POOL)
purpose: Each client's sellable holdings for BOW, uploaded in the BOW Admin terminal (User Stock upload): BOW's API cannot write holdings, so a file is the only route. Comma-separated, no header, CRLF, 16 fields, one line per client per security: DP quantity is the sellable demat quantity as Finspot's ISIN Holding has it (margin-pledged shares included, less lender pledges and CDSL freezes, plus unpaid purchases held in CUSPA; nothing for an account frozen for debits); pool quantity is the previous business day's delivery (CNC) buys less sells, not yet received (as Finspot's T1 file). Symbol and series come from the NSE security master, the BSE code from the BSE scrip file (both loaded on Exchange files). Lines with no DP and no pool quantity are left out. The credit-for-sale haircuts are the firm's (Connections → BOW upload files; 0 by default as in the broker's file, 100 on the pool gives no credit for sale). BOW takes user deposit and user stock files during market hours too (other files 17:30 to 08:00).

columns.name: BackOffice ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: NSE Symbol
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. NSE symbol (NSE security master); blank when the security has only a BSE code (as the broker's file)

columns.name: Series
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. NSE series (EQ, BE, BZ, SM, GB …); blank when the symbol is blank

columns.name: BSE Scrip  Code
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE scrip code (BSE scrip file); sometimes blank

columns.name: DPQuantity
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Holding quantity from the DP: the sellable demat quantity (as Finspot's ISIN Holding)

columns.name: DPAvePrice
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's average price of the demat holding (Holding.AvgCost; 0.00 when unknown)

columns.name: DPCFSHaircut
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Credit-for-sale haircut % on the DP holding (10 means 90% of the sell value is available). The firm's value in Connections → BOW upload files (default 0, as the broker's file)

columns.name: PoolQuantity
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Pool (T1) quantity: the previous business day's delivery buys less sells, not yet received (as Finspot's T1 file) ; 2 decimals as the broker's file

columns.name: PoolAvePrice
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Average price of the previous day's delivery buys (0.00 with no pool)

columns.name: PoolCFSHaircut
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Credit-for-sale haircut % on the pool (T1) quantity; 100 means no credit for sale (BOW API document). The firm's value in Connections → BOW upload files (default 0, as the broker's file)

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (BOW holdings file)
